description: This file provides custom implementations of snprintf and related functions for compatibility, including adjustments specific to Windows platforms. It defines functions git_vsnprintf and git_snprintf that internally call standard vsnprintf, handling buffer size issues and ensuring null-termination across different environments.

methods.name: int git_vsnprintf(char * str,size_t maxsize,const char * format,va_list ap)
methods.description: Performs a formatted string operation similar to vsnprintf, with additional buffer size adjustments for Windows compatibility.

methods.description: A wrapper around git_vsnprintf providing variadic arguments to produce a formatted string.
